projects.name: DriftSense
projects.description: Finds where a wafer-inspection microscope actually is — under unknown 8–12× zoom and ±5° rotation — or says the pattern isn’t there.
highlights: match F1 0.91 on 2,250 pairs · CAD-to-SEM within 1 px on 600

projects.name: CoronarySafe
projects.description: Label-free quality control for AI coronary-artery reconstructions from CT angiography: ranks scans so a reviewer checking a fixed 20% catches the critical failures that Dice hides.
highlights: sealed test, unseen segmenter: 29 of 64 critical failures in 32 of 160 reviews (best rule: 25) · normalised recall 0.906 · pre-registered

projects.name: AortaMix
projects.description: To our knowledge the first public simulation dataset of blood mixing in the aorta during peripheral VA-ECMO: adults at 50, 75 and 90% support, plus a child with a neck cannula. Research simulations of an idealized aorta, not for clinical use.
highlights: 3D spectral-element CFD (nekRS on an AMD MI300X) + 6,011 lumped-model samples · interactive viewer · short runs: the mixing zone had not settled at high support

projects.name: redline
projects.description: A batch-1 inference engine for one model on one GPU: Qwen3.8-27B on an AMD MI300X, Rust host and hand-written HIP kernels, no PyTorch at runtime.
highlights: 1k-token prompts: 5.56 ms/token vs vLLM 6.98 and SGLang 6.67 · exact mode: speculation gives the same tokens as plain decoding

projects.name: VehicleGPT
projects.description: Ask a car about its own data: a small LLM answering from CAN logs, fully offline.
highlights: hybrid 29.5% → 95.5% on 200 q · best single model 82% @ 1.74 s, 2 cores / 2 GiB

projects.name: Mouna
projects.description: Speak by mouthing words — silent lip-reading turned into voice on a phone NPU, no internet.
